latest.title: Real Update Downloads, Ghost Selection Guard & Virtual Key Overrides
latest.summary: Eliminated simulated updates and version spoofing in favor of real installer downloads, prevented random multi-line selection from stuck Shift modifier events in the editor, and hardened virtual unique key overrides for seamless cell editing.

highlights.title: Real Release Downloads
highlights.description: Removed simulated updater and local version spoofing. Direct installer download via default browser.

highlights.title: Ghost Shift Click Prevention
highlights.description: Prevents erratic multi-line text selection when single clicking after running queries or switching windows.

highlights.title: Virtual Key Editing Overrides
highlights.description: Prioritizes user-configured virtual keys over database schemas, allowing inline edits on tables without physical primary keys.
